statement: Public Uluru–Kata Tjuta management and heritage documentation describes Anangu traditional ecological knowledge as a detailed body of knowledge about ecological zones, plant and animal behaviour and distribution, foraging, and landscape management; park authorities state that this knowledge contributes directly to ecological research and management.

sources.citation: Australian Government, Uluru–Kata Tjuta National Park World Heritage description, updated 16 Apr. 2026.
Uluru–Kata Tjuta National Park Plan of Management, section on Tjukurpa and looking after country.

notes: This documents living, publicly shared knowledge used in management; it does not expose or summarize restricted knowledge.
